system.description: Effect: Creates 1,000 cubic feet of wood This spell creates a mass of wood equal to 1,000 cubic feet; it may be arranged in any fashion the caster desires (10' x 10' x 10' block, 25'x 20'x 2' wall, etc.) Casting time varies depending on the complexity of the design. A simple wall and other simple shapes take 1 round. A simple staircase may take 10 rounds (1 turn). A complicated design which is supposed to adhere to very tight specifications—such as the keel of a ship—could take the maximum time allowable, 12 turns (2 hours) just to work up in rough form. When the caster wants to try a complicated design, the DM decides how long the casting will take.
